title: Audit batteries: query-family self-audit and the collider inversion battery
description: Two families of instrument. The Family Module of the Self-Audit Module holds that single-rendering self-audit cannot see distributed erasure, and audits attribution across a query family through FC, ASI and CC, with a synthetic-family repair. The Inversion Battery runs on public collider anomaly-detection datasets: signal-trained directions outperform background-trained ones, the LCBH hypothesis predicts lower scores below the training distribution, and v0.2 requirements are stated. Also here are fixed-task capability audits, subjunctive semantic addresses and the claim that models trained on anthologies inherit the apparatus's erasure.
